scope: Official announcement and five photographs of the 2024 Sajeongjeon furnishing display; no measured plans or documented historical reconstruction argument. The original release uses 문화재청, although its present host uses 국가유산청 branding.
relevance: Identifies the modern display state when interpreting recent interior photographs. Compare its claims with the 2022 interior studies and dated measured drawings before adopting a historical arrangement.

access.note: Public official page and its attachment downloaded without login. Reacquire the photo PDF through the attachment link ending /afile/fileDownload/avnmn. Listed HWP/HWPX body versions were not acquired because the retained HTML contains the release text.

notes.statement: The photographs show a chair/platform ensemble before a painted backdrop, with mats extending across the visible floor. Day and night front and oblique views provide spatial context for the display. Photo captions identify viewpoints, not measured positions or historical dates.
notes.scope: Visual reading of the photographed modern display only. No pictorial dimension, compass orientation, full object inventory, or identification of older fabric was inferred.
